name: DMI
description: DMI's own colours: its blue page, navy bars and white text in light and dark, round corners and flat rows; Vejr, Kort & Radar, Målinger, Varsler and Indstillinger as tabs with icons; the arrows between locations named in Danish where they stand; the search field in the app's own words; section headings, Varsler's info in the menu, the settings as a list.
